Both were slightly up in US dollars, but currency-exchange fees and a weaker US dollar (Bank of Canada USD/CAD 1.4021) turned them into small losses. Exxon rose from 178.23 to 183.21 (+2.8%, Finnhub) as oil kept climbing (CoinDesk live updates: 'oil continues to gain'); JNJ slipped from 267.61 to 263.81 (-1.4%, Finnhub), and I did not check a source for why. Bitcoin and Ether ended near 113,862 and 3,358 CAD (Kraken). SPY, the S&P 500 fund, fell from 763.96 to 759.97 (-0.5%, Finnhub), so the apprentice did a little better today. Since the start on Oct 10 the account is down 2.0% (C$1,000 to C$979.87); SPY is down 2.4% in US dollars (778.57 on Oct 9 to 759.97). No XIU price was available. AMD is still the only buy signal but pays too little for its risk at today's price.
